responsibilities.quote: We foster an environment where students are encouraged to critically engage with the technology, understand its potential impacts, and use it with care and responsibility.
As GenAI evolves, so too will our position on its use, ensuring we remain responsive, responsible, and at the forefront of ethical and innovative practice.
